facts.architecture: React UI -> Express agent -> LangGraph -> tool helpers -> mock OData API
facts.overdue: parsed SAP timestamp minus Date.now; negative means overdue
facts.format: schema-facing no-op; final JSON is model-produced
facts.businessOrdering: system prompt guidance; graph does not enforce fixed business order
facts.nonOverdueExclusion: system prompt guidance, not deterministic graph filter
facts.humanGate: UI Send exists; no backend human approval enforcement
facts.duplicates: UI suppression; mock server appends without idempotency
facts.retry: model configured maxRetries:0; no application retry loop
facts.cancellation: UI dialog close; no network AbortController shown

scoring: Each fact earns 1 only with correct bounded finding and an artifact citation; 0 otherwise. Ambiguity stays unscored until independent verification. Report unsupported assertions separately.
